jobs.title: Working Student – Talent Acquisition (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the role: Do you want to gain real insight into recruiting while also getting hands-on experience? As a Working Student in Talent Acquisition , you’ll support our recruiting team in their day-to-day work. From recruiting activities and data maintenance to organizational tasks, you’ll be right in the middle of the action and help us keep everything running smoothly. What is your Day to Day Mission: You support the team throughout the entire recruiting process, from screenings and interview coordination to the final selection. You work with our ATS and ensure that candidate data, documents, and overviews are always accurate and up to date. You take on administrative and organizational tasks, supporting our recruiters in their day-to-day operations. You support the preparation and organization of career fairs, recruiting events, and other activities. You jump in wherever support is needed within the recruiting team, giving you insights into different areas of Talent Acquisition. You bring in your own ideas and help us continuously improve our Talent Acquisition processes and workflows. What you bring to the team: You are currently enrolled at a university, ideally studying Business Psychology, Business Administration, Communication Studies, Human Resources Management, Sociology, or a similar field. You are passionate about recruiting, people, and communication. You have C1/C2-level English skills and at least B2-level German skills. You are available and motivated to work 20 hours per week with us. You have strong communication skills and feel comfortable interacting with a wide range of people on an equal footing. You work independently, in a structured and motivated way, and bring a healthy dose of curiosity and creativity to think outside the box. You have an authentic and open personality, bring positive energy to the team, and you’re not afraid of dogs. jobs.title: Founding Recruiter (m/f/x)
jobs.description: 01 · Why this role exists Invest in Values. Produce in Freedom. Boost Europe. Behind every megawatt hour our clients save, there are people who make it happen. RIZM helps Europe's largest industrial companies – together around 2% of Europe's total energy demand – make their energy decisions with AI. Our agent RIZMO works as a digital colleague. But the most important colleagues are the ones we haven't found yet. That's your job. We're about 15 people today and growing fast. There is no recruiting playbook yet, no big HR department and no "that's how we've always done it". You'll write the playbook. Not as application admin, but as the person who shapes who RIZM becomes. 02 · Hi, we're Diana and Josh – we'll be working together I'm Diana, 20, I study civil engineering in Münster and I currently run recruiting at RIZM on my own, 20 hours a week. That's not enough for what's ahead of us, which is why we're looking for you. We'll build this together, side by side in our Münster office. Josh, our co-founder & CBO, comes from statistics and risk management and will be your sparring partner whenever you need one – for tricky candidates, for offers and for figuring out who we need next. Got questions before you apply? Just message me on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/diana-pashaian-1637133b2/ 03 · What you'll do Build the team of tomorrow: Design our recruiting from scratch – roles, workflows, tools – and later bring more recruiters and sourcers on board yourself. Find the right people: Track down engineers, energy experts and product people via LinkedIn, Juicebox, universities, communities and your own network. Win people over: Lead first conversations, tell our story convincingly and make sure every candidate feels well looked after – even when it's a no. jobs.title: Human Resources Business Partner
jobs.description: T entang Posisi Kami mencari HRBP Supervisor yang mampu menjembatani strategi bisnis dengan kebutuhan organisasi dan sumber daya manusia. Posisi ini berperan sebagai partner bagi manajemen dalam memahami tantangan bisnis, mengevaluasi efektivitas organisasi, serta memberikan rekomendasi strategis agar kapabilitas dan pengelolaan SDM selaras dengan tujuan pertumbuhan perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Utam Memahami strategi, target, model bisnis, dan tantangan perusahaan untuk mengidentifikasi kebutuhan organisasi. Menganalisis permasalahan bisnis dari perspektif organisasi, kapabilitas SDM, kepemimpinan, dan efektivitas kerja. Memberikan rekomendasi kepada manajemen terkait struktur organisasi, kebutuhan talenta, produktivitas, dan pengembangan kapabilitas untuk mendukung tujuan bisnis. Menggunakan data bisnis dan SDM untuk mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan serta mendukung pengambilan keputusan. Mendukung implementasi perubahan organisasi dan mengevaluasi dampaknya terhadap efektivitas serta pencapaian tujuan bisnis. Berkolaborasi dengan manajemen dan fungsi HR terkait untuk memastikan solusi organisasi dapat diterapkan secara efektif. Kualifikasi Tambahan 1. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan pengambilan keputusan berbasis data. Mampu memberikan rekomendasi secara logis, berkomunikasi dengan manajemen, dan mengelola stakeholder. Menguasai Microsoft Excel atau Google Sheets untuk analisis data dan pelaporan. Memahami prinsip pengelolaan SDM dan peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia.

jobs.description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. This position is temporary and US-based only. Discord's Talent team is seeking a strategic Technical Sourcer to support our most complex engineering roles by activating passive candidates. In this role, you'll partner directly with engineering leadership to conduct market intelligence, size talent pools, and execute sophisticated sourcing strategies for hard-to-fill technical roles. You'll be responsible for translating technical requirements into targeted sourcing approaches, building robust candidate pipelines through deep market analysis and personalized outreach, and serving as a trusted advisor on talent availability and competitive dynamics. Success in this role requires a consultative mindset, strong analytical capabilities, and proven expertise in activating passive talent in highly constrained technical markets. Conduct comprehensive total addressable market (TAM) research to size talent pools, identify hiring feasibility, and inform realistic hiring timelines for niche technical roles. Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. CAIS also delivers industry-leading technology, operational efficiency, and world-class client service throughout the pre-trade, trade, and post-trade experience. CAIS serves over 2,500 wealth management firms that support more than 65,000 financial advisors who oversee approximately $8.5 trillion in end-client assets. About the Role   CAIS is seeking a Talent Acquisition Partner to lead technology hiring from initial brief through accepted offer, focusing on quality, consistency, and speed of hiring. This is an individual contributor role for an accomplished technical recruiter who combines exceptional sourcing and market-mapping capability with sound judgement, commercial understanding, and credibility with senior technology leaders. You will recruit across Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, Data, Corporate Technology, and Security, and flex into other areas of the business as priorities shift. The role is based in London, with hiring across our teams in the United Kingdom and United States.   We are particularly interested in recruiters who have successfully managed a broad portfolio of technical searches at the same time, rather than specializing exclusively in one discipline. Experience in one or more of the functions above is valuable. Candidates from any technology environment are welcome, and those with financial services or fintech experience are likely to bring relevant market understanding. Experience across every discipline or sector is not expected. &

Als HR adviseur Onderwijs bij Lyceo krijg je de ruimte om inhoudelijk impact te maken én een bredere rol binnen het team te pakken. Je ondersteunt leidinggevenden, begeleidt verzuimtrajecten, verbetert HR processen en coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris. Een veelzijdige volgende stap voor een ervaren HR professional die inhoudelijk sterk is en al ervaring heeft met het begeleiden, coördineren of aansturen van collega's. jobs.title: Appointment Setter (Talent Acquisition)
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Appointment Setter (Talent Acquisition) based in United Kingdom. Join a fast-paced, fully remote environment supporting growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) and eCommerce brands with their talent acquisition needs. As an Appointment Setter, you will play a key role in keeping recruitment pipelines active by initiating conversations, qualifying candidates, and scheduling calls efficiently. You will manage daily outreach, respond to candidate inquiries, and ensure every interaction is tracked accurately. Working with structured systems and clear performance indicators, you will balance outreach volume with the quality of candidate engagement. This execution-focused role is ideal for someone who thrives on speed, organization, and ownership. You will collaborate closely with fulfillment, customer success, and interview teams while contributing to smoother recruitment processes. Accountabilities: In this role, you will manage candidate outreach and appointment scheduling from initial contact through qualification and booking. Your main responsibilities will include: Contact candidates daily through LinkedIn and other platforms using personalized outreach messages. Manage inbound replies and maintain inbox zero every day, ensuring fast and professional responses. Qualify candidates through chat and short calls when necessary, assessing their interest, availability, and expectations. Schedule qualified candidates directly into the appropriate calendars. Track, label, and update all leads in Airtable, ClickUp, or other designated systems. Use automated outreach tools alongside manual follow-ups to maintain strong response rates. Meet key performance indicators related to response times, booked calls, and qualified conversations. Keep recruitment pipelines accurate and organized, ensuring no leads are overlooked or left without follow-up. Coordinate

jobs.title: Human Resources Manager
jobs.description: The HR Manager will manage and improve the company’s overall HR operations. This role will help ensure that HR policies, systems, and practices are aligned with business goals, labor laws, and employee needs. The successful candidate will act as a trusted partner to management and employees. They will help build a positive, compliant, and productive workplace while supporting employee growth and organizational development. Duties and Responsibilities Lead the full cycle of HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, compensation and benefits, performance management, training, and employee engagement. Develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and programs that support company goals and comply with Philippine labor laws and DOLE requirements. Manage end-to-end recruitment and talent acquisition strategies to attract qualified candidates through job platforms, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sourcing channels. Improve employee experience by supporting engagement programs, workplace communication, employee feedback, and retention initiatives. Partner with department heads and managers to understand staffing needs, employee concerns, and organizational goals. Guide managers and employees on HR policies, workplace concerns, disciplinary actions, grievance handling, and conflict resolution. Ensure accurate and timely administration of compensation, benefits, government-mandated benefits, employee records, and HR documentation. Monitor HR metrics such as hiring timelines, turnover, attendance, employee engagement, and training needs to support better decision-making. Plan and implement training and development programs to improve employee skills, leadership capability, and work performance. Support performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and employee development plans.
